sections.title: Ring Box
sections.note: The box Vasu gives you, and its two upgrades.

items.name: Ring Box
items.howTo: Holds the rings you can wear (you wear one at a time); Vasu stores the rest.

tiers.name: L-1 Ring Box (1 ring)
tiers.howTo: Vasu gives it free the first time you talk to him at Vasu Jewelers in Lynna City.

tiers.name: L-2 Ring Box (3 rings)
tiers.howTo: Buy it for 300 Rupees in the hidden part of the Lynna Item Shop (present). Reach it by playing the Tune of Currents in the past where the shop's back room stands.

tiers.name: L-3 Ring Box (5 rings)
tiers.howTo: Linked only. With Ages played first: tell the Symmetry Secret (from the girl in Holly's house in the linked Seasons, after Snake's Remains) to the twins in the Middle House of Symmetry Village. With Seasons played first: get it in Seasons with the Ruul Secret, then tell the return secret to Farore.

items.notes: StrategyWiki says you need the L-2 box before the L-3 one; unverified.

sections.title: Magic Rings
sections.note: All 64 rings in ring-list order. Tick one once Vasu has appraised it; the Ring Secret shares them between linked files.

items.name: Friendship Ring
items.howTo: Vasu gives it to you free the first time you talk to him, together with the L-1 Ring Box.
items.notes: Effect: Symbol of a meeting. No effect. TourianTourist's ring guide says Vasu also gives it in a game started with the Hero's Secret, but not in a linked game; there, bring it over with the Ring Secret.

items.name: Power Ring L-1
items.howTo: Chest in the Spirit's Grave.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲, damage taken ▲. TourianTourist: +1 sword damage, +¼ heart on every hit you take.

items.name: Power Ring L-2
items.howTo: In a cave on Crescent Island in the past, reached with the Long Hook. Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Treasure Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲▲, damage taken ▲▲. TourianTourist: +2 sword damage, +½ heart on every hit you take.

items.name: Power Ring L-3
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. It comes from the linked Seasons game's Hero's Cave (Ages played first); bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲▲▲, damage taken ▲▲▲. TourianTourist: +3 sword damage, +1 heart on every hit you take; only beats the Red Ring with the Wooden Sword.

items.name: Armor Ring L-1
items.howTo: Inside the Great Moblin's Keep on Rolling Ridge (present).
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken ▼, sword damage ▼.

items.name: Armor Ring L-2
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. Get it in Seasons, in the Goron cave on Goron Mountain (needs the Roc's Cape), and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken ▼▼, sword damage ▼▼. TourianTourist: sword damage actually drops by only 1.

items.name: Armor Ring L-3
items.howTo: Linked game only, with Seasons played first: the Hero's Cave opens off the Maku Road in the linked Ages. Its last chest holds this ring. Zelda Wiki says you need the seventh dungeon's treasure to finish it.
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken ▼▼▼, sword damage ▼▼▼. TourianTourist: sword damage actually drops by only 1.

items.name: Red Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. Get it in Seasons from the Golden Sage in North Horon after slaying the four golden beasts, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ×2.

items.name: Blue Ring
items.howTo: On the Sea of No Return (past), under a statue by the Ancient Tomb. You need the Power Glove to move it.
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken = ½.

items.name: Green Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 5: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 3–5 spots: Crescent Island in the past (south of the Tokay statue) and, in a linked game, the Sea of Storms.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲, damage taken ▼. TourianTourist: sword damage ×1.5 and damage taken ×0.75.

items.name: Cursed Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Treasure Chest Game (three chests in a row), or the one-time ring in the Lynna City shop (300 Rupees).
items.notes: Effect: ½ sword damage, damage taken ×2. A challenge ring.

items.name: Expert's Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots.
items.notes: Effect: Punch when nothing is equipped. TourianTourist: an explosive punch doing 4 damage.

items.name: Blast Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. Get it in Seasons by the pirate ship on the Western Coast, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Bomb damage ▲.

items.name: Rang Ring L-1
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. Get it in Seasons in Samasa Desert, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Boomerang damage ▲.

items.name: GBA Time Ring
items.howTo: Buy it for 100 Rupees at the Advance Shop in Lynna Village (past). The shop only opens when Ages runs on a Game Boy Advance or Game Boy Player.
items.notes: Effect: Life Advanced! No effect. The Advance Shop stays closed on the 3DS Virtual Console. TourianTourist explains how to get the GBA rings there through Hero's and Ring Secrets.

items.name: Maple's Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Treasure Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the Wild Tokay game.
items.notes: Effect: Maple meetings ▲. Maple appears after 15 kills instead of 30. TourianTourist: you only need to wear it when the meeting would happen, not while slaying.

items.name: Steadfast Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. Get it in Seasons in the Sword & Shield Maze, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Get knocked back less.

items.name: Pegasus Ring
items.howTo: In a cave in the Sea of Storms, in the past (in the present in a linked game). You need the Zora Scale.
items.notes: Effect: Lengthens the Pegasus Seed effect (about twice as long).

items.name: Toss Ring
items.howTo: At the entrance of Mermaid's Cave in the present, with the Mermaid Suit, or as a Big Bang Game prize. Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Treasure Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the Wild Tokay game.
items.notes: Effect: Throwing distance ▲ (twice as far, Bombs included).

items.name: Heart Ring L-1
items.howTo: Linked: Temple Secret, with Seasons played first. Once the Great Fairy in Seasons gives you the ring, tell her return secret to Farore in the Hall of Secrets to get it here.
items.notes: Effect: Slowly recover lost Hearts while moving.

items.name: Heart Ring L-2
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Treasure Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Recover lost Hearts while moving (about twice as fast as L-1).

items.name: Swimmer's Ring
items.howTo: Linked: Diver Secret, with Seasons played first. Once the Master Diver in Seasons gives you the ring, tell his return secret to Farore in the Hall of Secrets to get it here.
items.notes: Effect: Swimming speed ▲ (twice as fast).

items.name: Charge Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots.
items.notes: Effect: Spin Attack charges quickly.

items.name: Light Ring L-1
items.howTo: In a cave in the Nuun Highlands.
items.notes: Effect: Sword beams at -2 Hearts (Noble and Master Swords only).

items.name: Light Ring L-2
items.howTo: A prize for scoring 350 points at the Lynna Village Shooting Gallery (past). Zelda Wiki says only 5% of wins give this ring, so expect to replay.
items.notes: Effect: Sword beams at -3 Hearts (Noble and Master Swords only).

items.name: Bomber's Ring
items.howTo: A perfect score on the Platinum level of the Goron Dance in the past (Rolling Ridge). The prize is either this ring or the Protection Ring.
items.notes: Effect: Set two Bombs at once.

items.name: Green Luck Ring
items.howTo: In Mayor Plen's house in Lynna City (present). You need the Long Hook.
items.notes: Effect: ½ damage from traps. TourianTourist calls it much easier to get in Ages.

items.name: Blue Luck Ring
items.howTo: In a cave by Zora Village; Zelda Wiki says above the village in the present, behind a rock you need the Power Glove for. Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Treasure Chest Game (three chests in a row), or the one-time ring in the Lynna City shop (300 Rupees).
items.notes: Effect: ½ damage from beams (Beamos). Ages location disagreement: Zelda Wiki says the cave above Zora Village in the present; TourianTourist lists Zora Village (past) plus the Sea of Storms (linked).

items.name: Gold Luck Ring
items.howTo: Inside Ambi's Palace (past).
items.notes: Effect: ½ damage from falls.

items.name: Red Luck Ring
items.howTo: A Goron in a cave on Rolling Ridge in the past asks for 20 Ember Seeds and 20 Bombs. Come back later and pick one of his two chests. It's also a 350-point prize at the Lynna Village Shooting Gallery. Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Treasure Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the Wild Tokay game.
items.notes: Effect: ½ damage from spiked floors.

items.name: Green Holy Ring
items.howTo: On the shore south of Fairies' Woods, reached through the Zora Seas, or for a perfect score on the Gold level of the Goron Dance. Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Treasure Chest Game (three chests in a row), or the one-time ring in the Lynna City shop (300 Rupees).
items.notes: Effect: No damage from electricity.

items.name: Blue Holy Ring
items.howTo: A 350-point prize at the Lynna Village Shooting Gallery (past). Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Treasure Chest Game (three chests in a row), or the one-time ring in the Lynna City shop (300 Rupees).
items.notes: Effect: No damage from Zora's fire (River Zoras only).

items.name: Red Holy Ring
items.howTo: In an underwater cave in the Zora Seas (present). You need the Long Hook. Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Treasure Chest Game (three chests in a row), or the one-time ring in the Lynna City shop (300 Rupees).
items.notes: Effect: No damage from small rocks (Octoroks). Seasons: Zelda Dungeon and StrategyWiki also list it as a Subrosian minigame prize, and TourianTourist marks it as having a fixed Seasons source without naming it. Unverified, so only the random sources are given here.

items.name: Snowshoe Ring
items.howTo: Linked: Mamamu Secret, with Ages played first. In the linked Seasons, after Poison Moth's Lair, Mamamu Yan's mother in the Floodgate Keeper's House tells you the secret. Tell it to Mamamu Yan in Lynna City, then find and carry back her lost dog.
items.notes: Effect: No sliding on ice. Zelda Wiki warns of a glitch where the dog vanishes for good, so save before telling her the secret.

items.name: Roc's Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Treasure Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the Wild Tokay game.
items.notes: Effect: Cracked floors don't crumble.

items.name: Quicksand Ring
items.howTo: A Big Bang Game prize. Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Treasure Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the Wild Tokay game.
items.notes: Effect: No sinking in quicksand. TourianTourist: also stops conveyor floors from moving you.

items.name: Red Joy Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Treasure Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Beasts drop double Rupees. TourianTourist: every Rupee picked up from the ground counts double.

items.name: Blue Joy Ring
items.howTo: Linked game only, with Seasons played first: Impa sends you into the Black Tower to save Princess Zelda from Vire (Zelda Wiki: after Moonlit Grotto). She gives you the ring.
items.notes: Effect: Beasts drop double Hearts.

items.name: Gold Joy Ring
items.howTo: Behind a bombable wall in a cave on Rolling Ridge (present).
items.notes: Effect: Find double items (Rupees, Hearts, Ore, Bombs and seeds from the ground).

items.name: Green Joy Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. Get it in Seasons on Mt. Cucco, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Find double Ore Chunks.

items.name: Discovery Ring
items.howTo: Chest in the Spirit's Grave.
items.notes: Effect: Sense soft earth nearby: a chime plays on screens with a Gasha spot.

items.name: Rang Ring L-2
items.howTo: Random ring, class 5: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 3–5 spots: Crescent Island in the past (south of the Tokay statue) and, in a linked game, the Sea of Storms.
items.notes: Effect: Boomerang damage ▲▲.

items.name: Octo Ring
items.howTo: A 350-point prize at the Lynna Village Shooting Gallery (past). Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Treasure Chest Game (three chests in a row), or the one-time ring in the Lynna City shop (300 Rupees).
items.notes: Effect: Become an Octorok. You can't use items, but Like Likes can't eat your shield.

items.name: Moblin Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Treasure Chest Game (three chests in a row), or the one-time ring in the Lynna City shop (300 Rupees).
items.notes: Effect: Become a Moblin. You can't use items, but Like Likes can't eat your shield. TourianTourist: late in the game the hilltop stump is only reachable through Snake's Remains.

items.name: Like Like Ring
items.howTo: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly. Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Treasure Chest Game (three chests in a row), or the one-time ring in the Lynna City shop (300 Rupees).
items.notes: Effect: Become a Like Like. You can't use items, but Like Likes can't eat your shield.

items.name: Subrosian Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. Get it in Seasons from Talon's Cave, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Become a Subrosian. You can't use items, but Like Likes can't eat your shield.

items.name: First Gen Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots.
items.notes: Effect: Become something: Link as he looked in the first Zelda.

items.name: Spin Ring
items.howTo: Linked: Plen Secret, with Ages played first. In the linked Seasons, after the power of Autumn, a golden Subrosian at Lava Lake (by the Bomb Flower) tells you the secret. Tell it to Mayor Plen in Lynna City.
items.notes: Effect: Double Spin Attack.

items.name: Bombproof Ring
items.howTo: A perfect score on the Gold level of the Goron Dance. Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots.
items.notes: Effect: No damage from your own Bombs.

items.name: Energy Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots.
items.notes: Effect: A sword beam replaces the Spin Attack.

items.name: Dbl. Edged Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲, but you get hurt on every hit you land. TourianTourist: +8 damage, 1 heart to you.

items.name: GBA Nature Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. It's sold at the Seasons Advance Shop, open only on a Game Boy Advance or Game Boy Player; bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Life Advanced! No effect. The Advance Shop stays closed on the 3DS Virtual Console. TourianTourist explains how to get the GBA rings there through Hero's and Ring Secrets.

items.name: Slayer's Ring
items.howTo: Defeat 1,000 enemies in this save file, then talk to Vasu and he hands it over.
items.notes: Effect: 1000 beasts slain. No effect. The count is per save file and isn't carried between games.

items.name: Rupee Ring
items.howTo: Collect 10,000 Rupees in this save file, then talk to Vasu and he hands it over.
items.notes: Effect: 10,000 Rupees collected. No effect. TourianTourist: every Rupee counts, even with a full wallet; digging with a Joy Ring is a quick way. StrategyWiki calls it the Wealth Ring; Zelda Wiki, Zelda Dungeon and TourianTourist all say Rupee Ring.

items.name: Victory Ring
items.howTo: Start a new game with the Hero's Secret (from beating Ganon at the end of a linked game). The ring waits in your inventory to be appraised.
items.notes: Effect: The Evil King Ganon defeated. No effect. StrategyWiki says you get it for beating the final boss of a linked game; Zelda Wiki, Zelda Dungeon and TourianTourist all say it comes with a Hero's Secret game.

items.name: Sign Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Ages. Get it from the Sign-Loving Subrosian in Seasons, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: 100 signs broken. No effect.

items.name: 100th Ring
items.howTo: Have Vasu appraise 100 rings in this save file (duplicates count), then he hands it over.
items.notes: Effect: 100 rings appraised. No effect. The count is per save file.

items.name: Whisp Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Treasure Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the Wild Tokay game.
items.notes: Effect: No effect from jinxes (Bubbles).

items.name: Gasha Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Treasure Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Grow great Gasha Trees: each kill counts double for Gasha growth, so a nut takes 20 kills instead of 40. TourianTourist: unlike Maple's Ring you must wear it while slaying for it to count.

items.name: Peace Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Treasure Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: No explosion if holding a Bomb.

items.name: Zora Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Treasure Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the Wild Tokay game.
items.notes: Effect: Dive without breathing.

items.name: Fist Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Treasure Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the Wild Tokay game.
items.notes: Effect: Punch when nothing is equipped (the weakest attack).

items.name: Whimsical Ring
items.howTo: Chest on the Zora Seas (present). Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Treasure Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▼, sometimes deadly (a very rare one-hit kill).

items.name: Protection Ring
items.howTo: A perfect score on the Platinum level of the Goron Dance in the past; the prize is either this or the Bomber's Ring. Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Treasure Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken is always one Heart.
